title: Oral B Vitality Precision Clean Toothbrush $25 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Oral B Vitality Precision Clean Toothbrush $25 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ The Good Guys

[SirFrankGrimes] Actually? Wouldn’t the bristles be too soft?
[vasdog123] oral-b's brush heads are quite tough on the gums and can promote recession
[Human224] What about the knock off heads from AliExpress that are a lot softer?
[tman88] I remember buying cheap ones from eBay years ago and they worked for a week or so until they stopped spinning. Stuck to getting real ones ever since.
[MeesusEff] I've been using my one for a few months, I've never had one stop spinning..
[jasonlah] for these older vitality style brush heads the precision clean is okay, but better to get the sensitive/gum care head. DO NOT get the floss action/ cross action/ whitening heads
[didactw] Just use sensitive clean. Only one dentists actually approve
[NSWbargains] This is unfortunately the standard price - have a look at the price history of the big two and pharmacies.
[mrvaluepack] Nope, current price is $50:
https://www.coles.com.au/product/oral-b-vitality-precision-c…
[NSWbargains] which word do you not understand? Price? Or history?
[mrvaluepack] you dont understand the meaning of 'standard price'?
[alpln] I find Phillips Sonicare much more gentle and effective
[Mokr] Really basic one. But design flaw in that the gap collects gunk.
[Jaes] Spent my store cash from the other deal and only paid $5. Good times
